facts.fact: The Médiateur Administratif says citizens can submit petitions through its website, a mobile app and its social network, and that 95 petitions came in through electronic channels in 2020.

The Médiateur Administratif publishes statistics from its 2020 annual report on files handled centrally, with 51% answered, 49% unanswered and 38% still being followed up, broken down by type of body.
